title: EvanZhouDev/openai-oauth exposes ChatGPT access through developer interfaces
friendlyTitle: OpenAI OAuth connects a ChatGPT account to developer tools
summary: OpenAI OAuth is an Apache-2.0 TypeScript toolkit that turns a locally authenticated ChatGPT account into an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and provides SDK and sign-in components for applications. It was the second-fastest-rising AI-related candidate in the day’s GitHub Trending collection.
friendlySummary: This trending project can make a signed-in ChatGPT account look like a normal OpenAI-compatible API for local apps and prototypes.
whyItMatters: Developers can connect local tools or prototypes to a familiar OpenAI-compatible API without rewriting clients. Because it relies on account authentication in a third-party project, review OpenAI’s current terms, token handling and the repository’s security model before using it or inviting other users to sign in.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It may save integration work, but check OpenAI’s rules and inspect how login tokens are stored before trusting it with your account.
